app.a_une_fin: This transaction has an end date
app.aide_certain: Untick for a quote or a hypothetical inflow
app.decochez: Untick the ones you don't want to project, then confirm.
app.faut_intitule: A label and an amount are required.
app.pas_recurrence: No recurring transaction found. At least 3 regular occurrences are needed. Your analysis is still available in the tabs below.
app.releve_aide: PDF, CSV or Excel. Columns and recurring transactions are detected automatically.
app.rien_a_projeter: Nothing to project yet. Confirm the recurring items above, or add your income and costs in the left panel.
app.rien_encore: Import a bank statement or add your income and expenses in the left panel. The calendar will then show your balance for every day ahead.
app.signature: See your cash, day by day.
app.sous_titre_ent: Your cash, your customers and your indicators.
app.sous_titre_part: Your budget, your spending and your future balance.
cal.pas_decouvert: No overdraft expected in the next {n} days. {bas}: {montant} on {date}.
cal.sous_zero: **Your balance goes below zero on {date}**, in {n} days. {bas}: {montant}.
compte.interet: An account lets you find your data on every visit, on any device. Without one the app still works — but everything is lost when you close the tab.
comptes.aide_devise: The currency this account is held in. It cannot be changed afterwards.
comptes.aide_totaux: Your accounts keep their currency. Only the total is converted.
comptes.origine_total: Where does this total come from?
comptes.vide: Add at least one account to start. Each account keeps its own currency.
cpt.aide_enr: Saving is automatic; this button forces an immediate write.
cpt.bandeau: **Your data will disappear when you close this tab.** Create an account in the left panel to keep it, or download your file.
cpt.compte_vide: Your account is empty. Your current data was kept — use “Save” to store it there.
cpt.confidentiel: Your financial data stays yours. We do not read it and do not sell it.
cpt.lecture_ko: Signed in, but could not read your data: {erreur}
cpt.pourquoi: An account lets you find your data on every visit, on any device. Without one the app still works — but everything disappears when you close the tab.
ent.chaque_fichier: Each file adds indicators. None is required.
ent.fc_donne: → collection time, unpaid invoices, customer dependency
ent.formats: Accepted formats: PDF, CSV, Excel. Columns are detected automatically, in French as in English.
ent.gagne_depense: What your business earns and spends, each month
ent.releve_quoi: What actually came in and went out.
ent.trois_fichiers: **Three possible files, none required.** Start with whatever you have at hand.
gen.aucune_donnee: No transactions to project yet. Confirm the recurring items detected above, or add your income and expenses in the left panel.
gen.avertissement: Indicative financial analysis, to be verified before any decision.
gen.exemple: You can also start from an example
gen.importez: Import a bank statement or add your income and expenses in the left panel. The calendar will show your balance for every day ahead.
rap.aide: The report covers your key figures, spending items and category breakdown.
releve.formats: PDF, CSV or Excel. Columns and recurring transactions are detected automatically.
sauv.aide_telech: A file you keep. It does not pass through the server.
sauv.rien_serveur: **Nothing is stored on the server.** Your accounts and transactions disappear when you close the tab. Download your file to find them later.
sc.aide_choix: Each scenario is compared with your current situation.
sc.aucune_op: Scenarios rely on your transactions. Import a statement and confirm the recurring items, or add your due dates in the left panel.
sc.combien_cassent: **{k} of {total} scenarios put you overdrawn.** The fastest is “{nom}”: {jours} days. That is how long you have to prepare.
sc.couteux: The costliest scenario is “{nom}”: {montant} less cash at {n} months than today.
sc.deja_sous_zero: **Your current situation already goes below zero** on {date}. The scenarios only worsen an existing problem — deal with that one first.
sc.explication: A scenario takes your transactions, applies an assumption, and recalculates your balance day by day. Your data is never modified.
sc.ligne_actuelle: The “Current situation” line is your path with no change.
sc.pas_decouvert: **None of the tested scenarios puts you overdrawn** over {n} months. Your position absorbs these shocks.
sc.placeholder_nom: E.g. I move to a new office
sc.que_tester: What do you want to test?
sc.selectionnez: Select at least one scenario above.
sc.supposer: What do you want to assume?
taux.explication: These rates are entered manually. Each carries its date and source so your totals stay justifiable.
